historical-dialogue.player: Hi, who are you guarding here?

historical-dialogue.npc: Can't say, all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not supposed to talk while I guard.

options.text: Hey, chill out, I won't cause you trouble.

steps.player: Hey, chill out, I won't cause you trouble. I was just wondering what you do to relax.

steps.npc: You never relax with these people, but it's a good career for a young man.

options.text: I had better leave, I don't want trouble.

steps.player: I had better leave, I don't want trouble.

steps.npc: Thanks, I appreciate that. Talking on duty can be punishable by having your mouth stitched up. These are tough people, no mistake.
